changes: Add optional beginWriteBatch capability for multi-file checkpoint publication.
MemorySpillAdapter stages all files privately, validates the complete observed-version set before publishing, and performs publication without asynchronous interleaving.
Share prepared-write validation, publication and accounting between single staged writes and batches.
Include all pending payloads in spill capacity; reject duplicate batch targets and writes after closure; clear transaction descriptors after commit/rollback.

cases: later-target conflict leaves earlier target unchanged
overlap budget rejection followed by complete rollback

remaining: Query sort and window writers are not yet wired to batch publication.
Remote/persistent adapters need an explicitly atomic implementation; an adapter must not advertise this capability through sequential ordinary writes.
Adapter directory/transaction metadata and native allocation failures are not an exact whole-heap accounting guarantee.
Full release gates and broader acceptance remain open.
